name: cloudformation
description: CloudFormation CloudFormation allows you to create and manage Amazon Web Services infrastructure deployments predictably and repeatedly.

subcommands.name: activate-organizations-access
subcommands.description: Activate trusted access with Organizations.

subcommands.name: activate-type
subcommands.description: Activates a public third-party extension, such as a resource or module, to make it available for use in stack templates in your current account and Region.

subcommands.name: batch-describe-type-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns configuration data for the specified CloudFormation extensions, from the CloudFormation registry in your current account and Region.

subcommands.name: cancel-update-stack
subcommands.description: Cancels an update on the specified stack.

subcommands.name: continue-update-rollback
subcommands.description: Continues rolling back a stack from UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED to UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE state.

subcommands.name: create-change-set
subcommands.description: Creates a list of changes that will be applied to a stack so that you can review the changes before executing them.

subcommands.name: create-generated-template
subcommands.description: Creates a template from existing resources that are not already managed with CloudFormation.

subcommands.name: create-stack
subcommands.description: Creates a stack as specified in the template.

subcommands.name: create-stack-instances
subcommands.description: Creates stack instances for the specified accounts, within the specified Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: create-stack-refactor
subcommands.description: Creates a refactor across multiple stacks, with the list of stacks and resources that are affected.

subcommands.name: create-stack-set
subcommands.description: Creates a StackSet.

subcommands.name: deactivate-organizations-access
subcommands.description: Deactivates trusted access with Organizations.

subcommands.name: deactivate-type
subcommands.description: Deactivates a public third-party extension, such as a resource or module, or a CloudFormation Hook when you no longer use it.

subcommands.name: delete-change-set
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified change set.

subcommands.name: delete-generated-template
subcommands.description: Deleted a generated template.

subcommands.name: delete-stack
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified stack.

subcommands.name: delete-stack-instances
subcommands.description: Deletes stack instances for the specified accounts, in the specified Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: delete-stack-set
subcommands.description: Deletes a StackSet.

subcommands.name: deregister
subcommands.description: Removes any tags from the on-premises instance; deregisters the on-premises instance from AWS CodeDeploy; and, unless requested otherwise, deletes the IAM user for the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: install
subcommands.description: Configures and installs the AWS CodeDeploy Agent on the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: push
subcommands.description: Bundles and uploads to Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) an application revision, which is a zip archive file that contains deployable content and an accompanying Application Specification file (AppSpec file).

subcommands.name: register
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM user for the on-premises instance, if not provided, and saves the user's credentials to an on-premises instance configuration file; registers the on-premises instance with AWS CodeDeploy; and optionally adds tags to the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: uninstall
subcommands.description: Uninstalls the AWS CodeDeploy Agent from the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: deregister-type
subcommands.description: Marks an extension or extension version as DEPRECATED in the CloudFormation registry, removing it from active use.

subcommands.name: describe-account-limits
subcommands.description: Retrieves your account's CloudFormation limits, such as the maximum number of stacks that you can create in your account.

subcommands.name: describe-change-set
subcommands.description: Returns the inputs for the change set and a list of changes that CloudFormation will make if you execute the change set.

subcommands.name: describe-change-set-hooks
subcommands.description: Returns Hook-related information for the change set and a list of changes that CloudFormation makes when you run the change set.

subcommands.name: describe-events
subcommands.description: Returns CloudFormation events based on flexible query criteria.

subcommands.name: describe-generated-template
subcommands.description: Describes a generated template.

subcommands.name: describe-organizations-access
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the account's OrganizationAccess status.

subcommands.name: describe-publisher
subcommands.description: Returns information about a CloudFormation extension publisher.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-scan
subcommands.description: Describes details of a resource scan.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-drift-detection-status
subcommands.description: Returns information about a stack drift detection operation.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-events
subcommands.description: Returns all stack related events for a specified stack in reverse chronological order.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-instance
subcommands.description: Returns the stack instance that's associated with the specified StackSet, Amazon Web Services account, and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-refactor
subcommands.description: Describes the stack refactor status.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a description of the specified resource in the specified stack.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-resource-drifts
subcommands.description: Returns drift information for the resources that have been checked for drift in the specified stack.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-resources
subcommands.description: Returns Amazon Web Services resource descriptions for running and deleted stacks.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-set
subcommands.description: Returns the description of the specified StackSet.

subcommands.name: describe-stack-set-operation
subcommands.description: Returns the description of the specified StackSet operation.

subcommands.name: describe-stacks
subcommands.description: Returns the description for the specified stack; if no stack name was specified, then it returns the description for all the stacks created.

subcommands.name: describe-type
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about an extension from the CloudFormation registry in your current account and Region.

subcommands.name: describe-type-registration
subcommands.description: Returns information about an extension's registration, including its current status and type and version identifiers.

subcommands.name: detect-stack-drift
subcommands.description: Detects whether a stack's actual configuration differs, or has drifted, from its expected configuration, as defined in the stack template and any values specified as template parameters.

subcommands.name: detect-stack-resource-drift
subcommands.description: Returns information about whether a resource's actual configuration differs, or has drifted, from its expected configuration, as defined in the stack template and any values specified as template parameters.

subcommands.name: detect-stack-set-drift
subcommands.description: Detect drift on a StackSet.

subcommands.name: estimate-template-cost
subcommands.description: Returns the estimated monthly cost of a template.

subcommands.name: execute-change-set
subcommands.description: Updates a stack using the input information that was provided when the specified change set was created.

subcommands.name: execute-stack-refactor
subcommands.description: Executes the stack refactor operation.

subcommands.name: get-generated-template
subcommands.description: Retrieves a generated template.

subcommands.name: get-hook-result
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information and remediation guidance for a Hook invocation result.

subcommands.name: get-stack-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the stack policy for a specified stack.

subcommands.name: get-template
subcommands.description: Returns the template body for a specified stack.

subcommands.name: get-template-summary
subcommands.description: Returns information about a new or existing template.

subcommands.name: import-stacks-to-stack-set
subcommands.description: Import existing stacks into a new StackSets.

subcommands.name: list-change-sets
subcommands.description: Returns the ID and status of each active change set for a stack.

subcommands.name: list-exports
subcommands.description: Lists all exported output values in the account and Region in which you call this action.

subcommands.name: list-generated-templates
subcommands.description: Lists your generated templates in this Region.

subcommands.name: list-hook-results
subcommands.description: Returns summaries of invoked Hooks.

subcommands.name: list-imports
subcommands.description: Lists all stacks that are importing an exported output value.

subcommands.name: list-resource-scan-related-resources
subcommands.description: Lists the related resources for a list of resources from a resource scan.

subcommands.name: list-resource-scan-resources
subcommands.description: Lists the resources from a resource scan.

subcommands.name: list-resource-scans
subcommands.description: List the resource scans from newest to oldest.

subcommands.name: list-stack-instance-resource-drifts
subcommands.description: Returns drift information for resources in a stack instance.

subcommands.name: list-stack-instances
subcommands.description: Returns summary information about stack instances that are associated with the specified StackSet.

subcommands.name: list-stack-refactor-actions
subcommands.description: Lists the stack refactor actions that will be taken after calling the ExecuteStackRefactor action.

subcommands.name: list-stack-refactors
subcommands.description: Lists all account stack refactor operations and their statuses.

subcommands.name: list-stack-resources
subcommands.description: Returns descriptions of all resources of the specified stack.

subcommands.name: list-stack-set-auto-deployment-targets
subcommands.description: Returns summary information about deployment targets for a StackSet.

subcommands.name: list-stack-set-operation-results
subcommands.description: Returns summary information about the results of a StackSet operation.

subcommands.name: list-stack-set-operations
subcommands.description: Returns summary information about operations performed on a StackSet.

subcommands.name: list-stack-sets
subcommands.description: Returns summary information about StackSets that are associated with the user.

subcommands.name: list-stacks
subcommands.description: Returns the summary information for stacks whose status matches the specified StackStatusFilter.

subcommands.name: list-type-registrations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of registration tokens for the specified extension(s).

subcommands.name: list-type-versions
subcommands.description: Returns summary information about the versions of an extension.

subcommands.name: list-types
subcommands.description: Returns summary information about all extensions, including your private resource types, modules, and Hooks as well as all public extensions from Amazon Web Services and third-party publishers.

subcommands.name: publish-type
subcommands.description: Publishes the specified extension to the CloudFormation registry as a public extension in this Region.

subcommands.name: record-handler-progress
subcommands.description: Reports progress of a resource handler to CloudFormation.

subcommands.name: register-publisher
subcommands.description: Registers your account as a publisher of public extensions in the CloudFormation registry.

subcommands.name: register-type
subcommands.description: Registers an extension with the CloudFormation service.

subcommands.name: rollback-stack
subcommands.description: When specifying RollbackStack, you preserve the state of previously provisioned resources when an operation fails.

subcommands.name: set-stack-policy
subcommands.description: Sets a stack policy for a specified stack.

subcommands.name: set-type-configuration
subcommands.description: Specifies the configuration data for a CloudFormation extension, such as a resource or Hook, in the given account and Region.

subcommands.name: set-type-default-version
subcommands.description: Specify the default version of an extension.

subcommands.name: signal-resource
subcommands.description: Sends a signal to the specified resource with a success or failure status.

subcommands.name: start-resource-scan
subcommands.description: Starts a scan of the resources in this account in this Region.

subcommands.name: stop-stack-set-operation
subcommands.description: Stops an in-progress operation on a StackSet and its associated stack instances.

subcommands.name: test-type
subcommands.description: Tests a registered extension to make sure it meets all necessary requirements for being published in the CloudFormation registry.

subcommands.name: update-generated-template
subcommands.description: Updates a generated template.

subcommands.name: update-stack
subcommands.description: Updates a stack as specified in the template.

subcommands.name: update-stack-instances
subcommands.description: Updates the parameter values for stack instances for the specified accounts, within the specified Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: update-stack-set
subcommands.description: Updates the StackSet and associated stack instances in the specified accounts and Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: update-termination-protection
subcommands.description: Updates termination protection for the specified stack.

subcommands.name: validate-template
subcommands.description: Validates a specified template.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: change-set-create-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until change set status is CREATE_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: stack-create-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until stack status is CREATE_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: stack-delete-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until stack status is DELETE_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: stack-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``describe-stacks``.

subcommands.name: stack-import-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until stack status is IMPORT_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: stack-refactor-create-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until the stack refactor status is CREATE_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: stack-refactor-execute-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until the stack refactor status is EXECUTE_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: stack-rollback-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until stack status is UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: stack-update-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until stack status is UPDATE_COMPLETE.

subcommands.name: type-registration-complete
subcommands.description: Wait until type registration is COMPLETE.
